summary: Tales traveling on God's rays, answers scatter in elastic truths of today particles simmering just below the horizon orange darts glisten with hope dancing on air #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Tales traveling
on God's rays,
answers
scatter in elastic
truths of today
particles
simmering just
below the horizon
orange darts
glisten with hope
dancing on
air
#smallpoems
